assignments.name: Voice agent context lost on Amazon Connect transfer
AI voice agent deflects routine calls
CallRail markets directly to customer executives

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Hey [PERSON_1], hey [PERSON_2]. Thanks for making the time. How's the week going down there in Tampa?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Busy. We're already in holiday prep mode, so this is a good break, honestly.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Same here. Call volume's been climbing for a couple weeks already.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: That tracks with what I saw in the numbers. Q3 showroom calls were up about 18 percent over Q2. Anything driving that beyond seasonality?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: A lot of it is the fall promotion, plus we've been running more Meta campaigns than we did in the spring.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Google too.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: And the AI Voice Agent is handling a lot of the after-hours and store-hours volume now, right?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Yeah. Containment's been trending up every month since we turned it on. Order status calls and store hours are the bulk of it.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: What's the split look like between order status and store hours these days?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Roughly two to one, order status. Though store hours spikes on weekends when people are out driving around.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: And it's been a relief for the stores, honestly. The front desk used to get buried in those calls.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Good. Now, I want to spend most of today on a few things: the Q3 recap, then the Amazon Connect piece [PERSON_2] flagged, and then planning for the holiday window.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Sound okay?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Works for me.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Yeah, let's do it.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: So, top line. Call tracking attributed about 41,000 calls to campaigns in Q3. Google Ads offline conversions went over fine, and Meta matched well.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Nothing broke on the integrations side.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Good. And the PreSense results?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: That's the part I wanted you to talk about, actually.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: PreSense has been the surprise of the year. Agents can see which mattress the person was looking at, and close rates on those calls are up.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Up meaningfully?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: A few points, which on our volume is real money. The agents love it. They're not guessing anymore.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: My team asks for it on every call now. If a screen pop doesn't show, they notice.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: That's great to hear. Did you roll it out to all 64 showrooms or just the pilot group?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: All of them, as of mid-September. Took a couple of weeks to train everyone but it stuck.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Okay. [PERSON_2], you wanted to raise something on the contact center side?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Yeah. It's the handoff from the voice agent into Amazon Connect. When the voice agent transfers to a person in Amazon Connect, the agent sees nothing. No order number, no reason for the call. The customer has to start over.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: So the context the voice agent collected doesn't carry over into the agent's screen?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Right. The customer already told the bot they're calling about an order, gave the order number, and then the live agent asks for it again.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: It's a bad look.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: How often is it happening?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Every transfer. It's not intermittent. Maybe 400 transfers a week right now, and it'll be more in November.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Got it. Let me ask a couple of questions so I can take this back accurately. Is the transfer landing in a specific queue, or does it route by intent?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: By intent. Order status goes to one queue, everything else goes to the general line.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: And the agents are all in Amazon Connect, no other desktop in front of them?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Just Connect. That's it.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Okay. I don't want to guess at this on the call. Let me take it to the team and come back with what's possible and what it would take.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: That's all I'm asking. I just want it on the radar before the holiday rush.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: It is now. I'll follow up by end of next week, even if the answer is just an update.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Appreciate that.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Anything else on your list before we talk holiday planning?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: One thing, and it's more of a heads up. CallRail reached out to our CMO directly. I'm not worried, but you should know they're circling.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: How recent?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Last week. Some email about our call tracking setup. Our CMO forwarded it to me and asked if we were happy.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: And you told him you are?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: I told him about PreSense and the containment numbers. That ended the conversation.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Okay. I won't make a thing of it, but thank you for telling me.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Of course. I'd rather you hear it from me.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: So, holiday planning. What does the promo calendar look like?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Black Friday promo starts the 20th of November, runs through Cyber Monday, then a second wave mid-December.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: We're staffing up the contact center the week before, so the voice agent is going to carry a lot of the early overflow.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Do you want me to set up a check-in the week of the 16th, just to make sure nothing's wobbling during the surge?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Yeah, that would help.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Please. And can you pull the Q3 numbers into a one-pager for me before then? I want to bring it to our exec meeting.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: I'll have it to you by Monday.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Perfect.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Okay, I think that's everything on my end. I'll send the recap today, and I'll have the Amazon Connect item in front of the right people this week.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Thanks, [PERSON_3].

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Thanks. Talk soon.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Talk soon, both. Have a good one.
